reasoning.ade_dynamic_error_beta0.5_trim0.6: series_profile.model_landscape.concept_drift=true → dynamic error weighting adapts to changing model performance across validation windows
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.combination_recommendation.method_hint=ade_dynamic_error AND recommended_knobs.shrinkage=0.35 → inverse-RMSE weights with moderate shrinkage aligns with recommended regularization
reasoning.best_per_horizon_by_validation: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=false → per-horizon selection captures differentiated model performance across forecast horizons

excluded_highlights.ridge_stacking_l250_topk3: series_profile.combination_recommendation.avoid=ridge_stacking → regularization guide recommends avoiding ridge stacking with few validation windows
